description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Cogwork Assembler twice by paying {14}, creating two token copies of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Cogwork Assembler tokens, untapping The Eternity Elevator
Repeat.
